tdt.source: Eldred et al. 2010, Tables 2 and 3; PDF pages 4 and 6 visually checked
tdt.preparation: Tr-WT native TDT myosin transgene in Mhc10; 2-3 day females; demembranated parallel bundle of 8-10 large fibers; 15 C; sarcomere length 3.6 um
tdt.solution_caution: Methods give 10 mM MgATP mounting bath; Results explicitly report 20 mM MgATP and 0 mM Pi for active tension and Vslack. Preserve this source discrepancy.
tdt.uncertainty: Reported mean +/- SE, not specimen tolerance. Individual data and covariance unavailable.

cm9.source: Mahoney et al. 2014 Table 1 first w1118 7-day row and Figure 5
cm9.preparation: 7-day virgin female w1118; cranial CM9 fiber in pinned retracted proboscis; 0.5 mM Ca and 3 mM Mg modified HL3; controlled bath temperature not specified

quantal_content.kind: mean of per-NMJ EPSP/mEPSP ratios, not ratio of aggregate means

foreleg_probe.kind: Measured instrument calibration matrix transcribed from archived author code; not motor-unit force trials
foreleg_probe.units: column 1 micrometres, columns 2..7 balance readings multiplied by 1e-7 kg; g=9.8 m/s2 as source
foreleg_probe.source_preprocessing: Subtract first row for MATLAB columns 2,3,5,6,7. Stack columns 2..6 only and drop NaN. Column 3 loses every value due to NaN baseline; column 4 is not baseline-subtracted; column 7 excluded. Exact source handling retained.
foreleg_probe.split: Instrument-only diagnostic: all retained source columns reproduce published calibration; fit source columns 2,4,5 and reserve column 6 for descriptive prediction. Column/collection identities, not randomized biological specimens; no prespecified empirical acceptance margin.
